title: Foundations: Sleep Songs - The Complete Guide
summary: What Sleep Songs is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Sleep Songs songs: Ambient vocal music floats: voices as texture over slow-evolving pads, made for focus, sleep, and meditation. Enya, Brian Eno's vocal works, and modern sleep-music producers define the space.

History: Brian Eno's Music for Airports (1978) invented ambient; Enya's Watermark (1988) added Celtic vocals. Streaming made functional music — sleep, focus, meditation — a major genre.

How the songs work: Sleep Songs favors the keys of C, G, F, D. Common forms include No verse-chorus; gradual evolution; Wordless vocals or repeated mantras. Players should master long reverb tails and slow attacks first, then layered vocal pads. Pads and voices; no strumming needed.
